page_title: INT 2-2 LAZ | Inter v Lazio 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
90+9' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+9' Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+8' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90+8' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+7' Mario Gila is being substituted because of an injury. Marco Baroni sends Samuel Gigot (Lazio) on the pitch.
90+7' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+6' Some great play by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Yann Sommer sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+5' The game is interrupted now, Mario Gila (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+5' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) fails to score from close range. He picks up a rebound, but sends it wide of the target!
90+4' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Christos Mandas intercepts the ball.
90+3' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+2' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Here is a change. Alessandro Bastoni is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Nicola Zalewski (Inter).
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is replacing Hakan Calhanoglu.
90+1' Substitution. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) in, Henrikh Mkhitaryan out.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 2 - 2 Goal! Pedro (Lazio) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Yann Sommer.
90' Pedro (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' Referee Daniele Chiffi has finally had enough of Marco Baroni and gives him a straight RED CARD!
88' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Simone Inzaghi, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
87' It’s a PENALTY to Lazio after the VAR review!
87' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Chiffi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lazio using VAR. This could be interesting!
86' That looked a certain handball by Yann Bisseck (Inter) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
86' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' Pedro (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
83' Pedro (Lazio) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

83' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Christos Mandas pulls off a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.

79' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Hakan Calhanoglu sends a cross in from the set piece and Denzel Dumfries (Inter) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the left post and the score changes to 2:1.
78' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
78' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
74' No offside! Referee Daniele Chiffi points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Lazio players celebrate.
73' Attention! Referee Daniele Chiffi straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
72' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Matias Vecino laid the ball off to Pedro (Lazio), who shot from close range into the top left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
70' Taty Castellanos plays a lovely pass into Boulaye Dia (Lazio), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
68' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Augusto (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
67' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.
66' Mario Gila (Lazio) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
65' Lazio earn a corner.
65' Problems for Marco Baroni as Nuno Tavares is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) replaces him.
64' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
64' The ball is cleared after Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
61' Mario Gila (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Chiffi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find Taty Castellanos, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
58' 6:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
56' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Mehdi Taremi will be replaced by Joaquin Correa (Inter).
55' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
53' The manager makes a subsitution with Pedro (Lazio) coming on for Gustav Isaksen.

49' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Nuno Tavares (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
48' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Yann Bisseck (Inter) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

45+2' Corner kick falls to Federico Dimarco (Inter), who does his best to finish into the bottom left corner. His mid-range shot is diverted onto the post by one of the defending players, who prevents him from scoring a goal.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A yellow card for bad language! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

42' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Yann Sommer anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.

41' He should have scored! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Wasted effort! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
40' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Matias Vecino, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
40' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
38' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
37' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
34' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
34' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
33' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley goalwards, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save and to deny him.
28' Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
26' Federico Dimarco receives a sweet cross inside the box from Nicolo Barella (Inter), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
25' Nicolo Barella (Inter) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
23' Yann Bisseck (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
21' The linesman signals that Federico Dimarco (Inter) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
20' The referee blows his whistle as Adam Marusic (Lazio) was too aggressive in his challenge. Inter have a free kick from a promising distance.
18' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find Matias Vecino with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
17' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Christos Mandas, who smothers the ball.
12' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends a long cross over to Nicolo Barella, but Christos Mandas comes forward to gather the ball.
11' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
10' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
5' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to find Mehdi Taremi with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' Matias Vecino (Lazio) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Inter will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
